video_title: I Bought My Mom Her Dream Car! ❤️ (Emotional)

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the financial realities of buying a luxury car
quotes.excerpt: I just don't think it'd be the financially smart thing to go buy a super expensive house.
quotes.quote: This is a super dope opportunity to be able to do something like this. Every kid dreams of it. I was in a position, obviously being on two-way and stuff, where I didn't have the finances to be able to do something like this, but it's always something I wanted to do in the back of my mind. Hopefully, I get on a real contract, 50-60 million, be able to get them a house, but on the current contract I'm on, I just don't think it'd be the financially smart thing to go buy a super expensive house.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the importance of financial responsibility for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: Finances are very important. Don't do stuff you can't afford.
quotes.quote: As I was saying in my other video, finances are very important. Don't do stuff you can't afford. That's why I had to wait so long to be able to do something like this, so I feel it's finally dope that something was able to be done for my mom, especially on the day she just ran my kids camp for me. Every year she signs up and makes sure kids from the east side of Riverside, San Bernardino and everything have a day to come and get food, shoes, backpacks and stuff for the school year, and she runs that.
